text: If your income was less than $5,000: use the Tax Table unless you itemize deductions. This table allows about 10 percent of your income for charitable contributions, interest, taxes, medical expenses, etc. If your deductions exceed 10 percent, it will usually be to your advantage to itemize them and compute your tax on page 3.
If your income was $5,000 or more: compute tax on page 3. Itemize or use standard deduction, whichever is to your advantage.
